title: FY2025 Strategic Financial & Growth Objectives
summary: Targeted full-year revenue of $335M with minimum EBITDA margin of 35% and net retention rate > 120%.
content: For Fiscal Year 2025, executive leadership targeted total revenue of $335M with minimum EBITDA margin of 35%. Actual realized revenue was $338.2M with full-year EBITDA of $131.8M (38.97% margin), surpassing strategic targets across all four quarters.

title: Enterprise Churn Mitigation Protocol & SLA Thresholds
summary: Accounts with churn risk score >= 0.70 require C-level executive sponsorship, dedicated Solutions Architecture reviews, and bi-weekly health checks.
content: Accounts flagged with churn risk scores above 0.70 are categorized as Active-At-Risk. Immediate remediation requires: 1) Executive Sponsor assignment within 48 hours; 2) SRE latency remediation if risk is latency-related (Vanguard Media case); 3) Beta access to Edge Inference SDK for robotics/embedded clients (Alpha Robotics case); 4) Competitive displacement war-room (Pulse Health AI case).

title: Financial Audit & Discrepancy Reconciliation Standards
summary: Quarterly earnings representations must reconcile against verified ledger records within 0.1% tolerance. Unsubstantiated claims must be audited and flagged.
content: All public investor relations briefings and executive quarterly reviews must be checked by the Critical Reviewer & Verifier Agent before external distribution. Any variance greater than $100,000 between claimed figures and SQLite transactional records must trigger an automated audit warning and replanning event.

title: Global Sales Incentive & Deal Qualification Matrix
summary: Enterprise deals exceeding $2M qualify for executive deal-desk approval and Tier-1 discount structuring.
content: In FY2025, closed-won deals above $2.0M accounted for $13.45M in total bookings. Top performers include Marcus Vance (North America: $9.85M across 3 strategic accounts), Sonya Lindqvist (EMEA: $2.1M closed-won, $5.25M pipeline), and Kenji Sato (APAC: $2.95M closed-won).
